description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Alistar''' [[File:Remove Scurvy.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Removal|An icon representing the keyword Cleanse]] [[:Crowd control#Removal|cleanses]] himself of all [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control|An icon representing the keyword Crowd control]] [[:Crowd control|crowd control]]. For the next 7 seconds, he reduces incoming damage taken.
description.text: Active: Alistar cleanses himself of all crowd control. For the next 7 seconds, he reduces incoming damage taken.

notes.raw: * [[File:Hybrid penetration.png|20px|link=True damage|An icon representing the keyword True damage]] [[:True damage|True damage]] cannot be reduced by any means and will deal full damage to '''Alistar''' during ''Unbreakable Will''. * ''Unbreakable Will's'' modifier to incoming damage stacks additively with [[File:Vladimir OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Vladimir|An icon representing Vladimir]] [[Vladimir|Vladimir's]] [[File:Vladimir Hemoplague.png|20xpx|border|link=Vladimir#Hemoplague|An icon for Vladimir's ability Hemoplague]] [[Vladimir#Hemoplague|Hemoplague]] for a total reduction of 45/55/65%.(unexpected)
